mentions.name: QuickLaunch Start
mentions.description: A hybrid 'done with you' quick website launch offering that helps people get started, pairing tutorials and guidance with AI-assisted writing of text copy. Currently in testing with a launch planned for the 1st.
mentions.source_excerpt:
working on a hybrid done with you quick website launches ( https://betterwebgroup.com/quicklaunch-start/ ) to help people get started - using some tutorials and guidance for ai writing your text copy.
more than half baked now, testing on the 1st!
